name: whoop
description: WHOOP recovery, sleep, strain and workout data in Claude, via your own WHOOP developer app.

client_id.title: WHOOP Client ID
client_id.description: From your app at https://developer-dashboard.whoop.com (set its redirect URI to http://localhost:8787/callback).

client_secret.title: WHOOP Client Secret
client_secret.description: From the same WHOOP developer app. Stored in your system keychain.

redirect_uri.title: Redirect URI
redirect_uri.description: Must match the redirect URI registered on your WHOOP app exactly.
